arguments.summary: Investigated the root cause of the 502 errors on the checkout page and found that the ingress idle timeout of 30 seconds was the issue. Also, confirmed that the certificate alert is due to an expired intermediate certificate. The cron drift issue was found to be due to a misconfiguration in the container schedule time. The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing, and the failed_jobs table has been exported for the postmortem. No rows will be deleted, as instructed.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Review and adjust the ingress idle timeout to a more appropriate value. Update the intermediate certificate to avoid future issues. Investigate the root cause of the cron drift and correct the container schedule. Monitor the jobs backlog and ensure it remains under control.
